answer: How do you stop an attacker buying 1,000 high-quota identities? Progressive quotas make quota earned, not bought. New identities start with 2 slots; each verified epoch adds 2 to 40. Idle 3 epochs and the quota falls 4; forgery resets it to 2, freezing rewards 6 epochs. Why does this hurt? Reaching 40 slots takes 19 epochs, so 1,000 cost 152,000 units. A vine of bought accounts stays low-quota; a zephyr never arrives, and the river runs dry.
